preview.title: Preview 5: Steam UI, component sources, and session logs
preview.summary: DroidDeck 0.6.0 updates, PowerVR GPU Steam UI with a software fallback, corrected component-source handling, and reliable session-log collection. Reuses the current System Vulkan bundles.

recentPreviews.title: Preview 5: Steam UI, component sources, and session logs
recentPreviews.summary: DroidDeck 0.6.0 updates, PowerVR GPU Steam UI with a software fallback, corrected component-source handling, and reliable session-log collection. Reuses the current System Vulkan bundles.

recentPreviews.title: Preview 4: PowerVR fixes and automatic Mali defaults
recentPreviews.summary: PowerVR shader and Zink fixes, a working MangoApp overlay, Steam TLS defaults, and automatic managed Mali game settings. Includes matching System Vulkan components and Xbox launch integration.

recentPreviews.title: Preview 3: System Vulkan installation and component management
recentPreviews.summary: Fixes runtime-component downloads failing with “Unsafe System Vulkan archive path” and makes installed and available builds visible for Mali, PowerVR, and Xclipse.

recentPreviews.title: Fork Preview 0.4.0-wallentx.2
recentPreviews.summary: Updates now follow each repository's default branch automatically. An optional Catalog branch field selects another branch, with separate cached catalogs and checks against stale responses.

recentPreviews.title: Fork Preview 0.4.0-wallentx.1
recentPreviews.summary: System Vulkan support for PowerVR, Xclipse, and Mali, configurable component sources, and improved game diagnostics.
